images.alt: Цветные колониальные дома на улице Вальядолида — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide 16:9 premium travel website hero, photorealistic editorial illustration grounded in the place, natural textures and light, composition with calm uncluttered left side for white title. No words, logos, watermark, collage, frame or inset. Calzada de los Frailes in Valladolid Yucatan Mexico, a quiet narrow colonial street with low single-story pastel ochre pink pale blue houses, timber doors, stone pavement and restrained iron lanterns, a few flowering plants. Ordinary small Mexican town architecture with white cornices and irregular aged plaster, tropical sunlight after morning, street recedes to right. No invented cathedral, no Spanish European city, no cars dominating.
